pieces.name: west_block
pieces.notes: West block: dark north trapezoid with a 45 deg NW hip, horizontal ridge line about y=410-418, large lit SW face below. E-W ridge.

pieces.name: centre_wing
pieces.notes: Centre wing: lit north hip-end triangle with apex at (535,400), ridge runs south to about (540,540), lit south hip-end triangle widening to the south eave at y about 613.

pieces.name: east_block
pieces.notes: East block under the big tree; direction is a guess from the trace shape (taller than wide). Low confidence.

notes: Axis-aligned single-story hip home. Trace overshoots the north eave by about 32 px (navy band), excluded. West block E-W hip, centre wing N-S hip (north and south hip-end triangles visible), east block under a dense tree (canopy excluded, direction guessed). Confidence medium for west and centre, low for east.
